title: Credits and additional taxes — the Moreaus
instructions: Compute selected 2025 amounts for the Moreaus (married filing jointly). Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Facts
exhibits.content:
- Wages: Jules **$230,000**; Anne **$40,000**. Each employer withheld additional Medicare tax only on wages above $200,000.
- Net investment income: **$30,000**; MAGI: **$300,000**.
- Children: Leo, age 8, and Mae, age 15, both qualifying children.
- Day care for Leo while both parents work: **$7,000**. Credit rate at their AGI: **20%**.
- 2025 child tax credit: **$2,200** per qualifying child under 17; phaseout begins at $400,000 MAGI for joint filers.

rows.label: Child and dependent care credit
rows.explanation: One qualifying child: expenses limited to 3,000 × 20% = **600**.

rows.label: Additional Medicare tax withheld by Jules's employer
